content: Qeeseta May7o
Qeeseti Xoossa Dunkaanen ooththiza wode may7ana may7o, salo misatiza, ochcha teera misatizanne xeeqa zo7o qacinappe daddida. Aaroone qeeseteththaa may7oka GODAY Muse azazida mala ooththida.
Qasse istti eefude worqqafe, salo misatiza, ochcha teera misatizanne xeeqa zo7o qacinappenne liiqo laynoppe daddida.
Istti worqqa qoxxi lee7isidi, izappe qarari qararidi qacina kessida. Histtidi salo misatiza, ochcha teera misatizanne xeeqa zo7o qacinanne liiqo layno gaththidi kushe hiillanchchati daddida.
Nam7u baggay gaaggidi issino gidana mala nam7u hashe bolla gaththidi oyththiza carqqa giigsida.
GODAY Muse azazida mala hiillay alleqissidi daddida danccoyka eefudera issife gididi, worqqafe salo misatiza, ochcha teera misatizanne xeeqa zo7o qacinappenne liiqo laynoppe dadettides.

Istti margide geetettiza nam7u shuchchata giigsidi worqqafe medhdhida shuchchu oykkizayssa bolla maarara woththida. Maatafa bolla sunth wooci xaafiza mala he shuchchata bolla Isra7eele nayta sunth woocidi xaafida.
GODAY Muse azazida mala tammanne nam7u Isra7eele qommota hassa7issizaaz gidana mala, ha tammanne nam7u shuchchata eefudezara oyththidi hashe kaqoza bolla woththida.
Tira Bolla Diza Kiise
Istti tiran woththiza kiise kushe hiillan ooththida. He tiran woththiza kiiseza eefude worqqafe daddida mala, salo misatiza, ochcha teera misatizanne xeeqa zo7o qacinappenne liiqo laynoppe daddida.
Izas oyddu xeeray dees; dhoqqateththaynne aahoteththay issi issi tadhdhako.
Hessafe guye iza bolla oyddu maaran al7o shuchchata woththida; koyro maaraan woththida shuchchay sardiyoone, tophaaziyoonenne xolqiza inqqu;
nam7anththo maaran baluure, simpere almaaze geetettiza al7o shuchchata;
heedzdzanththo maaran yaakintte, kelqedoonenne ametesxinoose;
oydanththo maaran birille, margidenne yasphiide. Heyta ubbaa worqqafe oosettida shuchchu oykkizayssa bolla woththida.
Isra7eele nayta sunththaa qooda mala, shuchchata qoodaykka tammanne nam7a; issay issay maatame mala woocettidi tammanne nam7u qommota sunththi he shuchchata bolla xaafettides.
Tiran diza kiisezas wodoro mala dooqettida sansalataa walakay baynda worqqafe medhdhida.
Nam7u worqqafe medhdhida shuchchu oykkizaytanne nam7u worqqa migidota medhdhidi tiran woththiza kiisezas qommo gaxa xeerata gaththi oyththida.
He nam7u worqqa sansalatata tiran woththiza kiisezas xeeran diza migidotara gaththi oyseththida.
He sansalatatas hankko bagga xeeraa qasse eefudezas sinththa baggara, hashe kaqo bolla diza shuch oykkizaytara gaththi qachchida.
Qasseka nam7u worqqa midigata medhdhidi eefudeppe kaalli diza tira kiisezas soo baggara diza nam7u xeeratan aaththida.
Hessaththoka worqqafe hara nam7u migidota medhdhidi, eefudezas sinththa baggara, hashe kaqozappe garsa baggara eefude xeessan qachchizayssafe qommora, sikoy gaaggizaso achchan istta oyththida.
GODAY Muse azazida mala tira kiisen diza migidota eefudezan diza migidotara gaththidi, salo misatiza suqeththan qachchida gishshas tira kiisezi xeessafe bollara diza gishshas, qashoy dol7enna.
Qeeseti Mayza Hara May7ota
Eefudezappe bollara may7iza qamisa istti mulera salo misatiza carqqafe giigsida; hessika shemmaane oosokko.
He qamisazas qoodhe aaththizaso medhdhida; qoodhesoy daakettontta mala, soo bagga qalam7idi yuushshi aaththi sikkida.
Istta qamisazas duge bagga maccara yuushon salo misatiza, ochcha teera misatizanne xeeqa zo7o qacinappenne liiqo laynoppe oroomaane geetettiza miththa ayfe teera misleta medhdhida.
Qasseka worqqafe daalata medhdhidi qamisatas duge bagga xeera yuushshi aaththidi oroomaane misleta giddon aaththi aaththi walakkida.
GODAY Muses azazida mala istti Xoossa Dunkaane ooso ooththishe may7ana mala qamisazas duge bagga maccara yuushshi aaththidi daalanne oroomaane teera misle walakki aaththida.
GODAY Muse azazida mala istti Aaroonessinne iza naytas shemmaaney daddida liiqo laynoppe qolleta giigsida.
Qasse hu7en xaaxiza shaasheta, qoobetanne garsara may7iza may7ota liiqo laynoppe daddidi giigsida.
Hessaththoka qasse istti salo misatiza, ochcha teera misatizanne xeeqa zo7o qacinappenne liiqo laynoppe daddidi kushe hiillan alleqissidi dancco giigsida.
Istti akilile misle walakay baynda worqqafe medhdhidi maatame bolla woociza mala iza bolla, «GODAAS geesh gididi dummatides» gizayssa wooci xaafida.
Hessafe guye hu7e goossa bolla kaqqana mala, GODAY Muse azazida mala salo misatiza baqeth izan aaththidi qachchida.
Musey Oosoza Ubbaa Xomosides
Xoossa Dunkaaneza oosoy wuri mulera polettides. Isra7eele asay ubbaa GODAY Muse azazida mala ooththides.
Hessafe guye istti Xoossa Dunkaaneza mulera ekkidi Musekko ehida; hessika dunkaanezanne iza miishshaza ubbaa, qapheta, tole miththata, penge gordiza miththata, tuussatanne istti eqqiza tohota,
bollara kammanaas dharshoza ite zo7o qalamen yeggi kessidayssa, qaacettida galba, genththiza magalasha,
Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa, iza tookkiza tooho miththata, atto geetettiza kamaa,
xaraphpheezanne iza miishshe ubbaa GODAA sinththan woththiza geeshsha ukeththaa,
walakay baynda worqqafe oosettida xomppe woththizasozanne izan maaran diza xomppeta, istta miishshata ubbaanne xomppe zayte,
worqqafe oosettida exaane cuwasizasoza, tiyettiza zayte, sawiza exaane, Xoossa Dunkaane penge magalasha,
xarqimalappe ooththida yarshizasoza, xarqimala zayzareza, iza tookkiza tooho mith, iza miishshata ubbaa, meechcha kerenne kereza iza bolla woththiza miishshata,

Dunkaanezas kare bagga wuyge godaa genththiza magalashata, iza tuussata, istti eqqiza tohota, Dunkaanezas kare bagga wuyge geliza pengeta magalashata, Dunkaanezas kare bagga wuyge wodorotanne dhishketa, Xoossa Dunkaanezas koshshiza miishshata ubba;
Qeeseti Geeshsha soon ooththidi may7anaas dadettida may7ota, Aarooneynne iza nayti qeeseteththan ooththishe may7iza may7ota.
Isra7eele asay oosoza ubbaa GODAY Muse azazida mala ooththides.
Musey oosoza xomosi xeellidi istta GODAY azazida mala ooththidayssa be7ides. Hessa gishshas Musey istta anjjides.

footnotes.text: Midiga gizayssa issi issi bagga Gamoththo qaalan migido woykko cuuphe geetettees.
